query.rawSql: SELECT name AS __text, id AS __value FROM boards WHERE id IN (SELECT board_id FROM board_access WHERE login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})

list.name: assignee
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT assignee_name FROM issues WHERE owner = ${__user.login:sqlstring}

targets.rawSql: SELECT i.issue_key, i.summary FROM issues i JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.issue_id = i.id WHERE bi.board_id = ${board:sqlstring} AND i.assignee_name IN (${assignee:sqlstring}) AND i.summary LIKE '%${search}%' AND bi.board_id IN (SELECT board_id FROM board_access WHERE login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
